en.headline: Police raid Tai Po flat used as gambling den, arrest 32
en.dek: Tai Po officers searched a Kwong Fuk Road unit on Tuesday evening, seized six mahjong tables and charged two men with operating a gambling establishment.
body: Tai Po Police District special duties officers raided a residential flat on Kwong Fuk Road at about 6pm on Tuesday and found what they described as a suspected illegal gambling establishment, local reports said on Wednesday.

A 40-year-old local man was arrested on suspicion of operating a gambling establishment. An 86-year-old local man was arrested on suspicion of operating a gambling establishment and of gambling in a gambling establishment. Another 30 people in the unit — 14 local men, 11 local women, one mainland man and four mainland women, aged between 32 and 91 — were arrested on suspicion of gambling in a gambling establishment.

Officers seized six mahjong tables, nine sets of mahjong tiles, furniture and HK$2,660 in cash. The two men suspected of running the venue have been charged with operating a gambling establishment. Twenty-three of those arrested have been charged with gambling in a gambling establishment and are due to appear at Fanling Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday morning. Seven others were released on bail and must report to a police station in mid-September.

Under the Gambling Ordinance, operating a gambling establishment carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment. Gambling in such a place carries a maximum fine of HK$30,000 and nine months’ imprisonment. Police said they would continue to act against illegal gambling.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福道住宅疑作賭檔 警拓32人最年長91歲
zh.dek: 大埔警區人員周二傍晚搜查廣福道一個單位，檢獲6張麻雀枱，兩名男子被控經營賭博場所。
body: 本地傳媒周三引述警方消息報道，大埔警區特別職務隊人員周二下午約6時突擊搜查廣福道一個住宅單位，搗破一個懷疑非法賭檔。
單位內一名40歲本地男子涉嫌經營賭博場所被捕；一名86歲本地男子涉嫌經營賭博場所及在賭博場所內賭博被捕。另外30人，包括14名本地男子、11名本地女子、1名內地男子及4名內地女子，年齡介乎32至91歲，涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。
行動中檢獲6張麻雀枱、9副麻雀、一批家具及2,660元現金。兩名涉嫌主持的男子已被控經營賭博場所罪；另外23人被控在賭博場所內賭博，案件周四上午在粉嶺裁判法院提堂。其餘7人獲准保釋候查，須於9月中向警署報到。
根據《賭博條例》，經營賭博場所最高可判罰款500萬元及監禁7年；在賭博場所內賭博最高可判罰款3萬元及監禁9個月。警方表示會繼續打擊非法賭博活動。
